Experience: Desirable: Experience in the relevant projects field & basic knowledge of computer application Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on date of interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PH/EWS/Ex-Service Man/Women As per the Govt. of India guidelines Other conditions: Engagement subject to being declared medically fit by the competent medical authority Desirable: Experience in the relevant projects field Basic knowledge of computer application

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AU Kota Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Concealing of facts and canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification Application forms received after the prescribed time and date will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Emoluments paid as per the rules of the funding agency. Purely temporary and project time bound; may be co-terminated with the project or availability of grant, whichever is earlier, without prior notice Initially for the financial year 2026-27 or till further orders; may be extended on performance, project need and funding agency approval No legal right to claim regularization, absorption or further contractual engagement Agreement on Rs. 100/- non-judicial stamp for engagement as contractual services Selection cancelled automatically if the candidate fails to join within the stipulated time

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Filled application form (duly typed) All original academic qualification/desirable/essential documents One set of self-attested copies of the documents Character certificate No Objection Certificate from the employer (if already employed)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AU Kota Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application format from the university website https://aukota.org. Fill the application form as per the enclosed format. Attach all desirable/essential qualification documents. Send it by hard copy to Director Research, Directorate of Research, Agriculture University, Kota, Borkhera, Baran Road, Kota-324001 (Raj.) or by email to [email protected] . Submit up to 5:00 PM on 23 November 2026; no application is considered after this. Attend the interview on 25 November 2026 at 10:00 AM with original documents and self-attested copies.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview Right of engagement is reserved with the University Check the university website for any changes or amendment till the interview date Selected candidate signs an agreement at joining accepting the project terms given by the Principal Investigator

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AU Kota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AU Kota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Technical Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AU Kota Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Format enclosed; can be downloaded from the university website https://aukota.org) and send it to Director Research, Directorate of Research, Agriculture University, Kota, Borkhera, Baran Road, Kota-324001 (Raj.), by hard copy or email, to reach by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on date of interview). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/PH/EWS/Ex-Service Man/Women As per the Govt. of India guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 20,000 per month (Fixed).

faq.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agri./Horti. Desirable: experience in the relevant projects field and basic knowledge of computer application.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Engagement subject to being declared medically fit by the competent medical authority.

faq.answer: Concealing of facts and canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification. Application forms received after the prescribed time and date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview. Interview of eligible candidates on 25 November 2026 from 10:00 AM in the Committee Room, Directorate of Research.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and project time bound; may be co-terminated with the project or availability of grant, whichever is earlier, without prior notice. Initially for the financial year 2026-27 or till further orders; may be extended on performance, project need and funding agency approval. No legal right to claim regularization, absorption or further contractual engagement.
